vaquinha.semArrecadado: The organization has not reported how much it has raised yet.
vaquinha.soComSelo: Only a verified organization shows the Pix key and the support link.
vaquinha.ajustar: Goal, amount raised and how to support
vaquinha.pix: Organization's Pix key (CNPJ or random key)
vaquinha.link: Link to the support page (starts with https://)
vaquinha.contaTexto: What was done with the money
vaquinha.contaAjuda: No one's name, CPF, phone or address.
vaquinha.contaLink: Link to the receipt or report (https, optional)
vaquinha.retirarConfirma: Remove this report? Only possible in the first 24 hours.
vaquinha.denunciarAjuda: Mediation checks the organization and the fund. The organization does not learn who reported it.
vaquinha.valorInvalido: Write only the amount, for example 1,250.00.

peticao.metaAjuda: From 10 to 10 million. The number only shows from 3 signatures.
peticao.metaInvalida: The goal goes from 10 to 10 million signatures.
peticao.entregarAjuda: With the text, who it is for and the number of signatures. No names: Alumia does not hand over who signed, not even to the organizers.
peticao.poucas: The document is available from 3 signatures.

documento.nota: Each signature was made with an Alumia account, one per account. This document carries only the number: Alumia does not hand over the names of who signed.

erros.sem_permissao: Only the treasury or whoever manages the organization can do this.
erros.caixa_existe: There is already a fund with that name.
erros.so_com_selo: Pix key and support link only for verified organizations.
erros.dado_pessoal: Remove a person's name, CPF, phone, e-mail or address.
erros.prazo_passou: The 24 hours have passed: the report stays.
erros.consentimento: Sign in to Alumia to do this.
erros.so_quem_organizou: Only the organizers of the action can do this.
erros.peticao_existe: This action already has a petition.
erros.poucas_assinaturas: The document is available from 3 signatures.
erros.entre_primeiro: Sign in to Alumia to do this.
erros.semBanco: This part is not live yet.
